log.title: Sworn in as President
log.body: Golden Fixture takes the oath of office. Review the budget and your departments: the nation is watching your first decisions.

log.title: Embassy opened in United States
log.body: A permanent mission now works in United States (₹15 crore a month). Relations improve and proposals are likelier to succeed.

log.title: Upgrading Primary care
log.body: ₹4,500 crore goes into the Health department's primary care. It gains a star in about a month.

log.title: Construction begins in India
log.body: Work starts on 500 × primary school for ₹500 crore. They open in a few weeks.

log.title: Construction begins in India
log.body: Work starts on 200 × health clinic for ₹300 crore. They open in a few weeks.

log.title: Police recruited in India
log.body: 2,000 officers join the force for ₹40 crore in training. Their pay comes out of the Home Affairs budget.

log.title: Police recruited in India
log.body: 5,000 officers join the force for ₹100 crore in training. Their pay comes out of the Home Affairs budget.

log.title: Intelligence service: strength 55
log.body: The intelligence service grows from 50 to 55 for ₹600 crore; its running costs rise with it.

log.title: Power project begins in India
log.body: Work starts on 4 × solar park for ₹6,000 crore, adding 0.4 GW on average. It connects to the grid in a few weeks.

log.title: Licence granted in India
log.body: An investor pays ₹180 crore for a licence to build a textile mill. It should open in about 2 months and pay corporate tax on its profits.

log.title: State plants sold in India
log.body: Investors pay ₹12,204 crore for 1 × steel mill. The plants keep running and employing the same people; from now on their owners keep the profit and pay corporate tax on it.

log.title: Trade rules for electronics
log.body: New rules for electronics: tariff 20%, no import quota, no ban.

log.title: Security gap at major airports
log.body: A surprise audit shows that screening at several airports and rail hubs can be bypassed.

log.title: Opened in India
log.body: 200 × health clinic open to the public.

log.title: Equipment delivered
log.body: 5 × Main Battle Tank Brigade Gen 2 (Armoured Brigade) have joined the forces.

log.title: Opened in India
log.body: 500 × primary school open to the public.

log.title: Connected to the grid in India
log.body: 4 × solar park now generate 0.4 GW on average.

log.title: Primary care: 3 stars
log.body: The Health department's primary care is now rated 3 of 5.

log.title: Security gap at major airports: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The upgrade is added to a long list of plans.

log.title: Private plant opens in India
log.body: 1 × textile mill start production.

log.title: United Arab Emirates proposes a non-aggression pact
log.body: United Arab Emirates proposes that neither country attacks the other for 5 years. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: China issues a warning to India
log.body: China’s government has made pointed statements about India’s conduct. A strong, visible military makes such talk less likely.

log.title: France proposes a trade contract
log.body: France offers a 3-year services contract worth ₹1,34,500 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Chance to address the nation
log.body: Broadcasters offer prime time for a national address. What will you talk about?

log.title: Friction with Venezuela
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Venezuela. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade
log.body: The service chiefs suggest a large parade to show the forces to the public and raise morale.

log.title: Chance to address the nation: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline and the slot goes to the opposition.

log.title: United Kingdom proposes a trade contract
log.body: United Kingdom offers a 3-year services contract worth ₹1,37,000 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The parade is shelved and units keep to their training schedule.

log.title: Gaffe in a live interview
log.body: An off-the-cuff remark in a live interview has gone viral for the wrong reasons.

log.title: France proposes a trade contract
log.body: France offers a 3-year services contract worth ₹1,38,200 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Shipping lanes disrupted
log.body: Blocked straits and rerouted vessels are lengthening delivery times and raising freight costs. Ports report fewer arrivals and customs receipts are falling.

log.title: Myanmar spy ring uncovered
log.body: Counter-intelligence caught agents of Myanmar probing military sites. No damage was done.

log.title: Australia proposes a trade contract
log.body: Australia offers a 3-year energy contract worth ₹1,39,500 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: China issues a warning to India
log.body: China’s government has made pointed statements about India’s conduct. A strong, visible military makes such talk less likely.

log.title: Landslides in the hills of the affected area
log.body: Heavy rain has triggered landslides on hill roads in the affected area. Highways are blocked and settlements are isolated.

log.title: Landslides in the hills of the affected area: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The central government stays out. Anger builds in the affected area.

log.title: Myanmar agents probe your defences
log.body: Foreign agents mapped sensitive sites before they were noticed. Readiness suffers while the leaks are plugged. Counter-intelligence reduces the risk.

log.title: Questions over a defence contract
log.body: A newspaper alleges inflated prices and favoured suppliers in a recent equipment contract. The opposition wants an inquiry.

log.title: Relief supplies diverted in the affected area
log.body: Reports say relief grain and blankets meant for the affected area were sold in the open market. Survivors are furious.

log.title: Relief supplies diverted in the affected area: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The denials ring hollow and the story grows.

log.title: Intelligence warning: The Hollow Banner plotting an attack in the affected area
log.body: Intelligence has picked up chatter that The Hollow Banner is preparing a strike in the affected area. There is a window of a few weeks to act.

log.title: France proposes a trade contract
log.body: France offers a 3-year services contract worth ₹1,41,900 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: South Africa proposes a non-aggression pact
log.body: South Africa proposes that neither country attacks the other for 5 years. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Friction with Vietnam
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Vietnam. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Questions over a defence contract: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The ministry insists the contract was sound. The press keeps digging.

log.title: Standoff on the border
log.body: Patrols from both sides have been eyeball to eyeball for days along a disputed stretch of the frontier. Tempers are high.

log.title: Intelligence warning: The Hollow Banner plotting an attack in the affected area: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You raise the alert level and wait.

log.title: Japan proposes a trade contract
log.body: Japan offers a 3-year tech contract worth ₹1,43,200 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Friction with Italy
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Italy. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Hoax bomb threats
log.body: A wave of hoax threats against schools and stations disrupts a day of travel before being declared false.

log.title: Standoff on the border: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Local commanders manage, but the standoff lingers.

log.title: Attack in India
log.body: The Hollow Banner carried out an attack in India. Emergency services responded; the nation mourns and demands answers.

log.title: The nation responds to the attack in the affected area
log.body: Funerals and vigils continue in the affected area. The public is looking to you for answers.

log.title: The nation responds to the attack in the affected area: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You leave it to the agencies. The public notices the silence.

log.title: Oil price spike
log.body: Crude prices have jumped on supply worries. Petrol, diesel and freight costs are rising across the country.

log.title: Intelligence foils a plot by Ashen Dawn
log.body: Agents uncovered Ashen Dawn preparing an attack in India. The cell was rolled up before it could act.

log.title: Australia proposes a trade contract
log.body: Australia offers a 3-year agriculture contract worth ₹1,45,700 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: China issues a warning to India
log.body: China’s government has made pointed statements about India’s conduct. A strong, visible military makes such talk less likely.

log.title: Displaced people arrive from Pakistan
log.body: Fighting and hardship in Pakistan are pushing thousands across the border. Local officials say shelters are filling and ask for guidance.

log.title: Oil price spike: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Prices follow the market. Households feel it at the pump and in the shops.

log.title: Displaced people arrive from Pakistan: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Border posts are reinforced. Neighbours criticise the decision.

log.title: Annual report 2026
log.body: The government closed 2026 with a deficit of ₹7,17,433 crore. Growth 6.4%, inflation 4.3%, unemployment 7.6%, debt 52.2% of GDP. Approval stands at 42.5%.

log.title: Opposition motion in Parliament
log.body: The opposition has tabled a no-confidence style motion in the House and wants a vote this month.

log.title: Intelligence foils a plot by The Ember Front
log.body: Agents uncovered The Ember Front preparing an attack in India. The cell was rolled up before it could act.

log.title: Japan proposes a trade contract
log.body: Japan offers a 3-year industry contract worth ₹1,48,200 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Opposition motion in Parliament: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You win the vote, but the debate leaves you looking defensive.
